name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – After § 5 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 5a. Expresses its deep alarm at the real and growing risk of a direct military confrontation, including nuclear confrontation, between NATO or EU Member States and the Russian Federation; stresses that the current situation in the Black Sea is the most dangerous flashpoint in the war and that the logic of reciprocal escalation must be broken now, before it becomes irreversible;
